name: Dean Murray

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Ministerios Sion, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Ministerios Sion, Inc. for all of the 2024 general taxes and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment of commissioners for the Seaview/Ocean Bay Park garbage district
sponsored.sum: Provides that the Seaview/Ocean Bay Park garbage district shall have 7 commissioners; provides for the requirements for appointment of such commissioners.

sponsored.t: Includes certain violations involving children as qualifying offenses for the purpose of imposing bail
sponsored.sum: Includes certain violations involving physical, psychological, or emotional harm to a child as qualifying offenses for the purpose of imposing bail.

sponsored.t: Relates to the handling of tips received through the office of the Medicaid inspector general's Medicaid fraud hotline
sponsored.sum: Relates to the handling of tips received through the office of the Medicaid inspector general's Medicaid fraud hotline; provides that the office of the Medicaid inspector general's Medicaid fraud hotline shall be the official Medicaid fraud hotline of the state of New York; directs the Medicaid inspector general to compile and provide to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly, the minority leader of the senate, the minority leader of the assembly and the attorney general an annual report containing information on tips received through the Medicaid fraud hotline.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. However, the potential for increased enforcement activity by local district attorneys may result in substantial increases in fraud recovery.

sponsored.t: Establishes a Medicaid fraud tip board and Medicaid fraud tip reward fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Medicaid fraud tip board which shall develop and administer a system offering monetary rewards to certain individuals reporting Medicaid fraud; creates a Medicaid fraud tip reward fund.
sponsored.fis: The Medicaid Fraud Tip Reward Fund would receive not less than one percent nor more than two percent of moneys recovered by the state through Medicaid fraud enforcement, along with any other moneys appro- priated, credited, or transferred to the fund pursuant to law.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Edward "Red" Corrigan
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a bridge on state route 112 over state route 27 to Edward "Red" Corrigan in the town of Patchogue, county of Suffolk.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town attorney of the town of Islip to be a nonresident of such town
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town attorney of the town of Islip, in the county of Suffolk, to be a nonresident of such town.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain salary increases of state officers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits salary increases for state officers that result in a salary above that of the governor.

sponsored.t: Relates to required training for school district officials
sponsored.sum: Provides that in each term for a trustee or voting member of a board of education of a school district or a board of cooperative educational services, elected or appointed, such trustee or member shall complete certain training and file a certificate of completion with a sworn statement of completion within the first year of such term; provides that failure to comply shall disqualify such trustee or member to serve.

sponsored.t: Provides for the care of retired law enforcement dogs
sponsored.sum: Directs the division of criminal justice services to establish a program for the care of retired law enforcement dogs which shall cover the cost of veterinary care for retired law enforcement dogs for the remainder of the lifetime of such dogs.

sponsored.t: Relates to contributions paid into the insurance reserve fund by the Medford fire district
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Medford fire district, located in Suffolk county, to deposit into the insurance reserve fund an amount of $400,000 in each of the years 2026, 2027 and 2028.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a death
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a death.

sponsored.t: Requires an annual report on perpetrators of violent crimes resulting in the death of a crime victim
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of criminal justice services to present an annual report on perpetrators of violent crimes resulting in the death of a crime victim.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Chief John "Jack" Blaum, Sr.
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of state route 27 to Chief John "Jack" Blaum, Sr. in the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state board of parole
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state board of parole; provides for appointments to such board.

sponsored.t: Adds nitazene to schedule I of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Adds nitazene to schedule I of controlled substances.

sponsored.t: Relates to school property and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Relates to school property and real property taxes; establishes the blue ribbon commission on property tax reform; relates to state assistance for local real property reassessment, state assistance to assessing units within a school district, providing a fixed real property assessed value for residential real property owned by certain persons over the age of 65 and providing state reimbursement to municipalities for lost real property tax revenue; requires the state to fund certain programs mandated for municipal corporations or school districts.
sponsored.fis: New York State would be required to pay for all new and expanded State mandates, with certain enumerated exceptions. In addition, New York State would be required to phase-in the payment of all real property tax levies for school districts that opt into the state-funded program. Finally, the State would pay school districts for any lost revenues attributable to capping the tax rate and assessment for senior citizens.

sponsored.t: Allows the alteration or repeal of real property tax exemptions for certain private institutions of higher education
sponsored.sum: Allows the alteration or repeal of real property tax exemptions for certain private institutions of higher education by the passage of a private bill by the legislature and approval by the governor.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effect the death of a defendant has on a pending appeal
sponsored.sum: Provides that if a defendant dies when they have a pending appeal, such appeal shall be dismissed and the trial court's judgment shall remain in effect.

sponsored.t: Requires industrial development agencies to only include jobs filled by residents of New York state when assessing the progress of projects that are provided financial assistance
sponsored.sum: Requires industrial development agencies to only include jobs filled by residents of New York state when assessing the progress of projects that are provided financial assistance.

sponsored.t: Sets forth notification requirements on abortions performed on minors
sponsored.sum: Requires parental notice prior to the performance of an abortion upon an unemancipated minor; defines unemancipated minor as person less than eighteen years of age; allows for waiver of such notice in limited instances; establishes circumstances and procedures for proceedings to obtain an order waiving such parental notification.

sponsored.t: Relates to yellow signals at traffic intersections
sponsored.sum: Relates to yellow signals at traffic intersections; requires traffic-control signals shall be examined and certified as accurate every two years.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminalizing the filming of the commission of a violent felony
sponsored.sum: Criminalizes the video recording of the commission of a violent felony and the conspiracy to record such video.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting supervised injection sites
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting supervised injection sites; provides that it shall be unlawful for any person to own, operate, work in or volunteer at a supervised injection site; defines terms and establishes penalties.

sponsored.t: Requires public utility authorities to obtain legislative approval before raising rates or fees, or imposing new rates or fees
sponsored.sum: Requires public utility authorities to obtain legislative approval before raising rates or fees, or imposing new rates or fees.

sponsored.t: Requires display of building numbers on all buildings to which numbers have been assigned
sponsored.sum: Requires plainly legible display of building numbers on all buildings to which numbers have been assigned; provides for a fine for violations of such requirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the period of limitation for the prosecution of sex offenses committed against children; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the period of limitation for the prosecution of sex offenses committed against children; such actions may be commenced within 15 years after such child has reached the age of 18.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary moratorium on unfunded mandates from the legislature and creates regional mandate relief councils
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary moratorium on unfunded mandates from the legislature and creates regional mandate relief councils.
sponsored.fis: This legislation could provide savings to local governments and school districts.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of state funds for non-residents seeking an abortion or related procedures
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of state funds for non-residents seeking an abortion or any other procedure that results in the intentional termination of a pregnancy at any stage of gestation.

sponsored.t: Requires detailed fiscal impact notes on certain legislation
sponsored.sum: Requires detailed fiscal impact notes on certain legislation stating the estimated annual cost to the political subdivision affected and the source of such estimate; provides that bills will be invalidated if the funding source is not provided or the fiscal impact results in an annual net additional cost in excess of $10,000.
sponsored.fis: This legislation could provide savings to local governments.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale or promotional distribution of machetes to minors
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale or promotional distribution of machetes to minors; defines machete as a large heavy knife with a broad blade, used primarily for cutting brush or vegetation.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of transportation to determine which entrances to parkways in the state are most frequently accessed by oversized commercial vehicles and to prevent such access
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of transportation to determine which entrances to parkways in the state are most frequently accessed by oversized commercial vehicles and to install certain barriers to prevent such vehicles from accessing such entrances.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effect of failed propositions on voter approval for remaining propositions not collectively exceeding the tax levy limit
sponsored.sum: Provides that in certain instances the school district budget will be approved if the majority of the votes cast are in the affirmative and if the budget, without the separate proposition or propositions, does not exceed the tax levy limit.

sponsored.t: Provides that people arrested in connection with felonies relating to sex offenses where the victim is less than 13 years old must submit a DNA sample
sponsored.sum: Provides that people arrested in connection with certain felonies must submit a DNA sample.

sponsored.t: Requires a joint report by the state board of elections and state education department concerning the safety of students and staff at schools used as polling places for elections
sponsored.sum: Requires a joint report by the state board of elections and state education department concerning the safety of students and staff at schools used as polling places for elections.

sponsored.t: Exempts community colleges from the imposition of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts community colleges from the imposition of the metropolitan commuter transportation mobility tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to the notification of county boards of elections of an individual's death
sponsored.sum: Relates to the notification of county boards of elections of an individual's death and the subsequent removal of such voter's name from the applicable registration roll.

sponsored.t: Establishes the metropolitan transportation authority control board
sponsored.sum: Establishes the metropolitan transportation authority control board.
sponsored.fis: This legislation could provide substantial savings to taxpayers and commuters in the MTA region.

sponsored.t: Establishes the offense of obstructing a police officer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the offense of obstructing a police officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to warning labels on cannabis and criminalizes certain violations of restrictions on the sale of adult use cannabis
sponsored.sum: Relates to warning labels on cannabis products; includes advertising, deceptively advertising, branding, marketing, packaging, displaying, labelling, offering for ingestion outside of packaging, or administering cannabis products in contravention of a certain section of the cannabis law or rules and regulations in the criminal sale of cannabis in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "pupil privacy act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "pupil privacy act" which requires schools to notify the parents or legal guardians of every student when a student protected information survey will be administered and provide such parent or legal guardian the opportunity to opt their child out of taking such survey.

sponsored.t: Relates to wage claims for manual workers
sponsored.sum: Relates to wage claims for manual workers; establishes an exception is provided from certain legal relief for instances of when payment is made within fourteen calendar days after the end of the week in which the wages were earned.

sponsored.t: Requires fair business practices in franchises
sponsored.sum: Requires fair business practices in franchises.

sponsored.t: Designates certain offenses against law enforcement officers as hate crimes
sponsored.sum: Designates certain offenses against emergency medical services personnel, firefighters, and law enforcement officers as hate crimes; includes the definition of emergency medical services personnel, firefighters, and law enforcement officers.

sponsored.t: Facilitates compliance with the sex offender registry for offenders without a registerable residence
sponsored.sum: Facilitates compliance with the sex offender registry for offenders without a registerable residence; defines "homeless sex offender" and "sex offender registration officer"; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of manual worker
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of manual worker; provides such worker's primary duty is to engage in physical labor.

sponsored.t: Grants dealers in firearms access to the NYSPIN database
sponsored.sum: Grants dealers in firearms access to the New York Statewide Police Information Network to allow law enforcement the opportunity to question persons that attempt to sell stolen firearms.

sponsored.t: Provides for the installment payment for the earned income credit
sponsored.sum: Provides for the installment payment for the earned income credit.
sponsored.fis: The bill would result in lower government expenditures for emergency financial assistance (such as emergency HEAP or other emergency finan- cial assistance) by increasing the effective monthly income of the work- ing poor.

sponsored.t: Prohibits local government action which prevents the enforcement of federal laws
sponsored.sum: Requires that local governments comply with a detainer request issued by a federal law enforcement agency; requires that such local government not interfere with the ability of federal law enforcement officials to conduct enforcement activities at municipal or county jails in furtherance of their duty to enforce federal laws.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of dogs, cats and rabbits by pet dealers; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the sale of dogs, cats and rabbits by pet dealers in the state and those that sell such animals through an online platform.

sponsored.t: Adds xylazine to the depressants designated as controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Adds xylazine to the depressants designated as controlled substances with the exception of use in cattle or other nonhuman species if approved by the federal food and drug administration.

sponsored.t: Relates to the award of crime victim assistance funds for victims of overdoses where a substance was administered through deception or surreptitously
sponsored.sum: Permits award of crime victim assistance funds to victims of overdoses, where such overdoses cause death and were the result of deception, surreptitious delivery, or third-party administration of a controlled substance.
sponsored.fis: To be determined, however, the crime victim assistance fund is financed by criminal fines, forfeited bail bonds, and penalties paid by convicted offenders, not from tax dollars, so there should be no cost to the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes "Elijah's law"; and directs the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles to conduct a study analyzing the operation and use of certain vehicles
sponsored.sum: Increases driver safety training course requirements for D, M, and MJ license applicants; directs the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles to study the operation and safety of motorcycles, e-bikes, and scooters.

sponsored.t: Relates to unsealing unfounded child abuse and maltreatment reports in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Relates to unsealing unfounded child abuse and maltreatment reports upon a court order finding that justice requires the information in such reports is necessary for the determination of charges being investigated by a grand jury or for the purposes of prosecuting a violation of the penal law.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "public school instructional materials review and transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Requires school boards to make the final decision on whether to keep, remove, or restrict access to an instructional material in a school library; establishes a review process for formal complaints concerning instructional materials that are the subject of complaints.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. Since databases of such instructional materials already exist at most schools, there will be minimal fiscal impact. However, to the extent needed, it shall be state-aidable using technology reimbursement aid to pay for any cost a district would potentially incur to establish and/or maintain such database.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 581-d of the labor law relating to the interest assessment surcharge
sponsored.sum: Relates to the interest assessment surcharge.

sponsored.t: Enacts Josh's law, requires training plans be approved prior to implementation in modified and high school football
sponsored.sum: Enacts Josh's law; requires training plans be approved annually prior to implementation in modified and high school football by either the PSLA or NYSPHSAA, whichever is applicable; requires certain information regarding injuries be reported that occur during such practices.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of aggravated criminal concealment of identity
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of aggravated criminal concealment of identity.

sponsored.t: Enhances penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals; allows aggravated animal abuse to be considered for bail
sponsored.sum: Enhances penalties for aggravated cruelty to animals by making such offense a felony, including torture, beating, or killing of any animal; makes animal cruelty, including overdriving or depriving an animal of sustenance a felony when committed while released on recognizance for violating an order of protection; allows aggravated animal abuse to be considered for bail.

sponsored.t: Requires an independent forensic audit of the metropolitan commuter transportation authority
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan commuter transportation authority to contract with a certified independent public accounting firm for the provision of an independent, comprehensive, forensic audit of the authority to examine redundancies, inefficiencies, and the authority's governance system.
sponsored.fis: Additional costs to the metropolitan transportation authority for contracting with a certified independent public accounting firm to perform forensic audit and analysis services.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting on the metropolitan transportation authority's state of good repair
sponsored.sum: Relates to reporting on the metropolitan transportation authority's state of good repair; requires the reporting to be published on the authority's website, outlining the repairs and investments needed to restore the authority's existing transit systems to a state of good repair.

sponsored.t: Corrects a reference to the applicable tax assessment roll for a tax exemption granted to the Ruth AME Zion Church
sponsored.sum: Corrects a reference to the applicable tax assessment roll for a tax exemption granted to the Ruth AME Zion Church in the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk.

sponsored.t: Requires parents direct all appeals for school immunization exemptions to the director of the board of immunizations; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires parents direct all appeals for school immunization exemptions to the director of the bureau of immunizations; repeals provisions requiring such appeals be directed towards the commissioner of education.

sponsored.t: Defines lease-hold retirement community and proscribes rules and regulations for ownership and operation thereof
sponsored.sum: Sets up rules and regulations for the operation of lease-hold retirement communities located in a county with a population of more than one million inhabitants that only borders one other county, to provide adequate housing for senior citizens wishing to retire and locate in a lease-hold retirement community; grants owners of homes in lease-hold retirement communities the right to sell their homes by methods common to sales of residential property; requires that owners of lease-hold retirement communities offer owners of homes the option to sign a long-term ninety-nine year lease.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of agriculture and markets to establish licensing and educational standards for individuals providing canine training for non-service and non-police dogs
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of agriculture and markets to establish licensing and educational standards for individuals providing canine training for non-service and non-police dogs; requires such standards to utilize non-aversive, evidence-based, and positive reinforcement techniques.

sponsored.t: Requires all individuals who ride upon or operate an electric scooter to wear a helmet
sponsored.sum: Requires all individuals who ride upon or operate an electric scooter to wear a helmet that meets standards established by the commissioner of the department of motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to alienate certain parklands for use as a recharge basin
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk to alienate certain parklands for use as a recharge basin and to dedicate other lands as replacement parklands.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Calvary Full Gospel Assembly of God
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Calvary Full Gospel Assembly of God Church for the property located at 777 Sipp Avenue in East Patchogue.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from St. Mary AME Zion Church
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from St. Mary AME Zion Church for the property located at 537 Granny Road in the Hamlet of Medford.

sponsored.t: Defines lease-hold retirement community and proscribes rules and regulations for ownership and operation thereof
sponsored.sum: Sets up rules and regulations for the operation of lease-hold retirement communities to provide adequate housing for senior citizens wishing to retire and locate in a lease-hold retirement community; grants owners of homes in lease-hold retirement communities the right to sell their homes by methods common to sales of residential property; requires that owners of lease-hold retirement communities offer owners of homes the option to sign a long-term ninety-nine year lease.
